signed_error: all 100 clean positives; first 30 detailed objective traces; signed log gap estimated minus true; median, quantiles, histogram, boundary counts; compare true objective and nearest grid point, not use truth for decisions

controls.geometric: alternating sign extrema from waveform, estimate t_star from three successive peak times via geometric intervals; use early complete lobes, ratio consistency and robust median; no truth inputs; stationary corresponds to zero interval contraction and no finite t_star, not t_star=0
controls.stationary_rule: reject finite accumulation if median contraction <=0.02 or unreliable; shift origin controls including true t_star=0 for accumulating signals
controls.envelope: separate peak-envelope diagnostic with oracle log coordinate; compare log RMS slope and peak regression on training; evaluate held-out log-envelope shape and frozen detector decisions; no tuning
controls.pit: unconditional phase CI on all 100 positive cases per original noise group; use true zero drift only for scoring; Gaussian PIT from estimated drift and SE, report 10 bins and empirical coverage; no claim calibrated

staging: diagnosis first, then clean controls and PIT in separate jobs; no noisy geometric deployment or joint estimator until diagnosis reviewed
